referenceStudy.reference: Official public AVPBR Retextured R5 demo, Modrinth HC44ldY7
referenceStudy.scope: Opaque colour texels only (alpha >=250), excluding unused transparent skin space. R5 is not established as the version in the trailer. Only dimensions/counts/statistics are exported, not copyrighted texture maps.
referenceStudy.brightnessDefinition: Rec.709 weights applied to stored RGB/255, matching the current Aurum heuristic; this is not a linear-light luminance measurement.

figures.title: Measured height polarity
figures.scope: Cut wood and bark need opposite treatment. The Ender-chest height is almost unrelated to brightness.
